integrity: The universal conclusions have explicit mathematical proofs, an embedded finite verifier and a complete depth-three witness; finite enumeration alone is not treated as a proof of infinite assertions.
scientific_limitations: Exact Littlestone ranks for general k>=4 are not determined; the theorem applies only to cycles of order 3k+2 and minimum-cardinality dominating sets. Worldwide priority and independent validation are not established.
title: Logarithmic online shattering of minimum dominating sets on connected cycles
